model_scope: accepted axisymmetric artifact evidence to topology-aware global-solver boundary

relations.name: source/map/artifact binding
relations.validity: all inputs are exact 32-byte SHA-256 digests

relations.name: overflow-safe signed root fraction
relations.equation: f=a/(a+b), evaluated as (a/b)/(1+a/b) when a<=b and 1/(1+b/a) otherwise

relations.name: magnetic mirror ratio
relations.validity: 0<B_low<=B_high; null represents an ideal unbounded ratio only when B_low=0

relations.name: stable covariance-aware ratio variance
relations.validity: independent/residual sigmas and shared additive common-mode sigma in T; rho in [-1,1]; covariance matrix PSD

relations.name: loss probability delta uncertainty
relations.validity: x<1; clipped to conservative interval; endpoint x=1 uses interval only

relations.name: conservative correlated interval
relations.equation: evaluate independent low/high errors adversely and the additive common-mode shift with the same sign in numerator and denominator; take enclosing ratio bounds
relations.validity: coverage-scaled bounds remain finite or fail typed

relations.name: topology segment boundary
relations.validity: interior candidates pass prominence-sigma, candidate-confidence, and segment-confidence gates

relations.name: canonical coupling record hash
relations.validity: record includes evidence, radii/roles, diagnostics, freshness, uncertainty, topology, and all identities

relations.name: build-time evidence reverification
relations.equation: recompute the domain-separated snapshot invariant digest, H_artifact, H_map, H_binding and all schema/model/adapter/identity/diagnostic/freshness predicates for every build
relations.validity: immutable retained bytes/map; current direct adapter contract is L1a 1.1 to 1.1; legacy input requires an allowlisted migration adapter

prohibited_shortcuts: building records from structural maps or caller-declared provenance strings
accepting an artifact without exact-byte, canonical-map, and source-map binding verification
fixed axial windows or implicit boundary cusps
overflow-prone sign products, root sums, coordinate differences, or mirror arithmetic
treating confidence or isotropic loss-cone geometry as a calibrated plasma closure
